cameras.description: Cameras to show, in order. Each item is a camera name or {camera, label}.

camera.description: A configured camera; the dropdown lists the gateway's cameras.

label.description: Shown instead of the camera name.

rows.description: Grid rows; 0 = automatic. More cameras than columns x rows are paged.

mode.description: live, or synchronised playback of every tile at playbackTime.

playbackTime.description: Shared playback position (epoch ms). Written back about once a second; writing it seeks every tile.

maxLiveStreams.description: Most live tiles connected at once (decoder/bandwidth budget). Further tiles show a paused placeholder.

tourSeconds.description: Advance to the next page every N seconds; 0 = off.

transport.description: Live video transport. auto uses the gateway's default; hls is low-latency HLS through the gateway's own port (about 1-2 s behind); webrtc is about 0.2-0.5 s behind but needs the media port reachable, and falls back to HLS when it is not.

showTimeline.description: Timeline of the union of the shown cameras' recordings.
